name: actions/morphing-icon-button
title: Morphing icon button
description: A toggle whose icon reshapes between states.

keyboard.action: Move focus to and from the button.

notes: A toggle button: a native `<button>` with `aria-pressed`, following the WAI-ARIA button pattern.
The accessible name does not change between states, as the pattern recommends; screen readers announce “pressed” or “not pressed”.
The icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`); the name comes from `label`.
Pressed buttons also get a tinted fill and outline, so the state is not carried by the shape alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The icon switches to its new shape at once, without the morph.
